headline: Blueface is giving everyone a glimpse into just how lucrative the streaming world can be,
body: Blueface is giving everyone a glimpse into just how lucrative the streaming world can be, revealing that he made an impressive $1 MILLION in only three months of streaming What makes the revelation even more interesting is that Blueface made sure to give DDG his flowers, showing appreciation for introducing him to the streaming space and helping him tap into an entirely new lane of entertainment and income. ddg.
